items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: when Freddie Green had the band and at intermission I went up to Freddie and I says, “Freddie, I want you to meet Mike Scott.”

ctx.x: Do you like what’s happened with the band since the Count passed on?

They’ve kept the tradition. They’ve played a few new things here and there, but they play a lot of the old things. Frank Foster had the band for a time, Grover Mitchell has the band now I think. Freddie Green, the guitar player, had the band for a while.
